title: Price any paint job in minutes.
text: Painters: price any paint job in minutes, and finally know what you really made. This is Coatwright.

title: Start free
text: Start your free fourteen-day trial with Google or your email. No credit card.

title: Set up once
text: Add your business, logo and prices once, in your own currency.

title: Quote room by room
text: Walk the job and tap in each room. Coatwright works out the walls, trim, coats and labour, using your own rates.

title: Pick the paint
text: Choose the brand, colour, type and sheen for every room, and see exactly how much paint it needs.

title: Paint tally & order
text: Your paint tally adds it all up, room by room, prices it into the job, and sends the order straight to your paint store.

title: Every kind of job
text: Exteriors, decks, cabinets, garage floors and commercial work too.

title: Send a pro quote
text: Send a clean, itemized quote with your logo, by email or text, in seconds.

title: Win it. Get paid.
text: Win the job, schedule it, turn it into an invoice, and log every payment.

title: Know what you made
text: And see what you really made: your profit, your real hourly rate, and who still owes you.

title: Coatwright
text: Try Coatwright free for fourteen days. Founding members get half price, for life.
